model: dT/dt = -alpha (T - T_ambient) + beta tau^2 (arXiv 2512.16705 eq. 6), per joint type
source: 28 real ARTI-H1 logs (humanoid_controller git history + working tree, 2026-10-24..11-16, ~50 min at 60 Hz), scripts/thermal/fit_thermal.py
note: leg motors heat only 0-6 C per session, so alpha / T_ambient are not identifiable (free fit gave negative alpha / 200 C ambient); alpha fixed at 0.001 1/s (~17 min time constant), T_ambient = session start temperature, beta least squares >= 0. Real session start temps 20-31 C.
